prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
(empty)

New part:
S001: The operational concept covers checked baggage from acceptance at airport bag-drop or transfer induction through screening, sorting, make-up, and handoff for aircraft loading.
S002: The system boundary includes the airport equipment and control functions that convey, screen, route, reconcile, and stage checked baggage.
S003: The boundary excludes airline aircraft loading activities beyond the handoff at the outbound load control point.
S004: At the passenger interface, the Pier 4 Bag-Drop Unit captures bag identification and accepts baggage for processing.
S005: The Transfer Bag Feeder provides a separate induction interface for eligible transfer baggage.
S006: The Induction Tray Conveyor presents bags in a controlled manner to the screening and sorting equipment.
S007: The Baggage Control System coordinates bag status, routing decisions, and operational visibility across connected equipment.
S008: The Baggage Control System is also known by the alias Velvet.
S009: The Concourse Zone Controller coordinates local equipment and conveyance within its assigned operating area.
S010: The Concourse Zone Controller is also known by the alias Mosslight.
S011: The Flight Data Gateway sends the Flight Cutoff Advisory.
S012: The Baggage Control System uses current flight and operating data to support routing decisions and maintain alignment with scheduled departures.
S013: The Concourse Zone Controller produces the Recovery Route Card.
S014: The Primary Crossbelt Sorter routes cleared bags toward the applicable make-up areas.
S015: The North Gate Scanner and South Gate Scanner provide screening interfaces for baggage moving through the system.
S016: The Image Resolution Desk supports review of screening images when automated processing requires operator assessment.
S017: The Secondary Inspection Chute provides a controlled path for bags selected for additional examination.
S018: The Explosives Response Team and Security Duty Manager coordinate security response and disposition for escalated screening events.
S019: The Bag Reconciliation Station supports verification of bag identity and processing status when system records or physical handling require reconciliation.
S020: The East Make-Up Conveyor and West Make-Up Conveyor convey routed baggage toward the relevant loading areas.
S021: The Carousel 7 Make-Up Unit supports staging of baggage for its assigned departure operation.
S022: The Outbound Load Control Desk provides the operational interface for confirming baggage readiness at the aircraft-loading handoff.
S023: The Airline Ramp Coordinator coordinates acceptance of staged baggage for ramp operations.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
response:
{"summary":"Scope: checked baggage processing from airport bag-drop or transfer induction through screening, sorting, make-up, and aircraft-loading handoff. The system boundary includes airport equipment and control functions for conveying, screening, routing, reconciling, and staging checked baggage; airline aircraft loading beyond the outbound load control point handoff is excluded.
Elements and functions: Pier 4 Bag-Drop Unit captures bag identification at the passenger interface and accepts baggage. Transfer Bag Feeder separately inducts eligible transfer baggage. Induction Tray Conveyor presents bags in a controlled manner to screening and sorting equipment. Baggage Control System (alias Velvet) coordinates bag status, routing decisions, and operational visibility across connected equipment; uses current flight and operating data to support routing and alignment with scheduled departures. Concourse Zone Controller (alias Mosslight) coordinates local equipment and conveyance within its assigned operating area and produces the Recovery Route Card. Flight Data Gateway sends the Flight Cutoff Advisory; recipient unspecified.
Primary Crossbelt Sorter routes cleared bags toward applicable make-up areas. North Gate Scanner and South Gate Scanner provide baggage screening interfaces. Image Resolution Desk supports screening-image review when automated processing requires operator assessment. Secondary Inspection Chute provides a controlled path for bags selected for additional examination. Explosives Response Team and Security Duty Manager coordinate security response and disposition for escalated screening events. Bag Reconciliation Station supports bag identity and processing-status verification when records or physical handling require reconciliation.
East Make-Up Conveyor and West Make-Up Conveyor convey routed baggage toward relevant loading areas. Carousel 7 Make-Up Unit stages baggage for its assigned departure operation. Outbound Load Control Desk provides the interface for confirming baggage readiness at aircraft-loading handoff. Airline Ramp Coordinator coordinates acceptance of staged baggage for ramp operations.
No explicit operating modes or normative requirements stated."}
